Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.analyst

Class AnalystReportService

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.analyst.AnalystReportService
@Service public class AnalystReportService extends Object
Builds the commercial analysts' long-range reports over the last twelve complete UTC months (see ReportWindow.trailingMonths(java.time.Clock)). The queries only return months that had activity; this fills in the rest with zeros, so every report has one entry for every month in the window.

  • Method Summary

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    ActivationReport
    getActivation()
    Builds the activation report: for each sign-up month in the window, how many of its clients ordered within 30 days, how many have ordered at all, and how soon.
    ClientActivityReport
    getClientActivity()
    Builds the client activity report: each month's active clients split into new, returning and reactivated, with the clients who lapsed.
    ConcentrationReport
    getConcentration()
    Builds the concentration report: each month's traded volume and the share of it from the top 1, 10 and 20 percent of trading clients.
    OrderSizeReport
    getOrderSizes()
    Builds the order size report: each month's filled orders by value band, with the mean and median filled order value.
    RetentionReport
    getRetention()
    Builds the retention matrix: for each sign-up month in the window, the share of its clients active in each month from then to the window's end.
    ScorecardReport
    getScorecard()
    Builds the scorecard: volume, filled orders, average trade value, active clients and registrations per month, each with month-over-month and year-over-year change.
